snippet.title: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake - Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome (back) to Erathia!  
 
From kingdom exploration, to strategic battles and heroes management, take a first look at Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake gameplay and discover how to shape your legend in one of the greatest Strategy Games, reimagined for an enhanced experience.  

Wishlist now on PC, PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S: http://mightandmagic.com/HMM3R

About Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake:

Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. 

Join Queen Catherine on her crusade to restore order to the kingdom of Erathia, torn apart by her father's assassination and the onslaught of invading factions. Explore a vibrant fantasy world, build spectacular towns, and lead mighty heroes in epic, tactical battles.

A legend reborn. The legacy continues.

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
